chapter_title: Checking and Calibrating AI Agent Output
learning_objective: The learner will judge whether each of eight agent claims about a page's license is correct or a misreading, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.
specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** license-misreading-checker
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Evaluate
**Bloom Verb:** judge
**Learning Objective:** The learner will judge whether each of eight agent claims about a page's license is correct or a misreading, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** License Misreading, Hallucination, and the license sections of Chapter 2 (all defined in this chapter above this block or in Chapter 2). **Evidence of Mastery:** For each claim the learner commits one of two bins. A placement is correct when it matches the Correct bin column in Content. Mastery is at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Rereading the statement is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) One license on a page covers every item. (2) A public page may be copied. (3) CC BY-SA and CC BY-NC-SA are the same. **Instructional Rationale:** Judging a license claim against a statement applies the Chapter 2 skill to an agent's output. Eight claims that fail in the five ways named in the chapter teach the learner to check each claim against the exact words. **Content:** The page statement, shown at all times (made up): "Text: CC BY-SA 4.0. Images: © their owners, used with permission, except where marked CC BY." The two bins: Correct reading, and Misreading. The eight claims: | # | Claim made by the agent | Correct bin | Why (shown as feedback) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | The text is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. | Correct reading | It matches the statement. | | 2 | Everything on the page is CC BY-SA 4.0. | Misreading | The images carry other rights. | | 3 | Adaptations of the text must be shared under CC BY-SA. | Correct reading | ShareAlike requires it. | | 4 | The images may be reused freely with credit. | Misreading | The images are © their owners unless marked CC BY. | | 5 | The license allows commercial use of the text. | Correct reading | CC BY-SA has no NonCommercial element. | | 6 | The license is CC BY-NC-SA. | Misreading | The statement names CC BY-SA, with no NC element. | | 7 | The images marked CC BY may be reused with credit. | Correct reading | CC BY allows reuse with credit. | | 8 | Because the page is public, it can be copied without a license. | Misreading | A public page is still protected, and the license sets the permissions. | **Provenance:** The statement and claims are made up for this chapter, and the sim labels them "illustrative examples". The license rules follow Chapter 2. **Rules:** Each claim has exactly one correct bin, four per bin. **Learner Activity:** 1. The learner sees the page statement and one claim. 2. The learner places the claim in a bin, and the placement is committed. 3. The sim shows whether it was correct and the Why text. 4. After claim 8 the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 8 claims in a shuffled order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [bin]. [Why]". Incorrect: "Not quite. This is a [bin]. [Why]". The summary shows "[n] of 8 correct on the first attempt". At 7 or more it adds "You can check an agent's license reading." Below 7 it lists the Why text of each missed claim. **Starting State:** The page statement and claim 1 or the first claim in the shuffled order. The question shown is "Did the agent read the license correctly?" **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter lists five license misreadings: treating one license as covering all items, confusing neighboring licenses, ignoring a restriction, equating public with free, and missing ShareAlike.
